name: BankBridge
description: Read-only access to your own US bank, credit card and investment accounts (balances, transactions, spending, recurring charges, cashflow and holdings), fetched live from 12,000+ institutions; it cannot move money, pay bills or place trades.

auth.instructions: Sign in to BankBridge in your browser (OAuth). The server supports Dynamic Client Registration, so no client ID or API key is needed. Paid: $5/mo per connected bank; a demo account with sample data is available.
